mapper.sql: SELECT rp.id, rp.room_id, rp.owner_id, rp.category, rp.title, rp.content, rp.urgency, rp.status, rp.handler_id, rp.handle_remark, rp.handle_time, rp.create_time, r.room_no AS roomNo, b.name AS buildingName, o.name AS ownerName, o.phone AS ownerPhone, h.real_name AS handlerName FROM t_repair rp LEFT JOIN t_room r ON r.id = rp.room_id LEFT JOIN t_building b ON b.id = r.building_id LEFT JOIN t_owner o ON o.id = rp.owner_id LEFT JOIN t_user h ON h.id = rp.handler_id

sql.if: AND (rp.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.room_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: ORDER BY FIELD(rp.status, '待处理', '处理中', '已完成'), rp.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_repair rp LEFT JOIN t_room r ON r.id = rp.room_id LEFT JOIN t_building b ON b.id = r.building_id LEFT JOIN t_owner o ON o.id = rp.owner_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_repair (room_id, owner_id, category, title, content, urgency, status, handler_id, handle_remark, handle_time, create_time) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{ownerId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content}, #{urgency}, #{status}, #{handlerId}, #{handleRemark}, #{handleTime}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_repair SET category = #{category}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, urgency = #{urgency}, status = #{status}, handle_remark = #{handleRemark} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_repair SET handler_id = #{handlerId}, handle_remark = #{handleRemark}, status = '已完成', handle_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_repair WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT status AS status, COUNT(*) AS num FROM t_repair GROUP BY status
